claims: The Artemis II crew successfully returned to Earth on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew returned to Earth with a splashdown in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II crew's splashdown occurred at 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PDT) on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew concluded a 10-day journey around the Moon.
Artemis II marks the first crewed mission to return from the Moon since 1972.
The Artemis II crew began reentry procedures around 5:05 p.m. ET on April 10, 2026.
The Orion crew module separated from the service module at 7:33 p.m. ET on April 10, 2026.
Splashdown occurred at 8:07 p.m. ET in the Pacific Ocean on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew was successfully recovered by the USS John P. Murtha.
The Artemis II mission completed on April 10, 2026.
